text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Right now, I am offering detailed explanations
regarding "Project L'Arc" to anyone interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
<username>,
do you need an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Now then, what would you like me to explain?
Speaking of what I wanted to ask about training for "Project L'Arc"—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Regarding "Training Goals," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In this training scenario, there are no target races
for individual Umamusume; you will be training them
toward conquering the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is the world's most prestigious race, held at ParisLongchamp Racecourse in early October during the Classic and Senior years."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Let's train together with the members of "Project L'Arc" and seize the title of world champion!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is
a steep and towering wall. Achieving the goal of
victory will surely be exceedingly difficult.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So first, let's earn "Supporter Pts",
which serve as proof of how many fans
are cheering on your trainee Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Supporter Pt can be earned through "SS Matches"
with L'Arc members or by placing in GIII or higher races.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And when you collect Supporter Pt...
the fans' "Expectation Level" rises,
and the training effects increase too!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Some training goals require obtaining Supporter Pt,
so make sure to actively collect them!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: In addition, as a secret measure for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, there are the 'L'Arc Representative Exchange Matches,' where you compete against overseas Umamusume in a VR space simulating Longchamp.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Representative Exchange Races will be held four times in total during training, with the first taking place at the end of this year.
Let's prepare thoroughly and give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation
regarding "Training Goals."
Is there anything else you would like to know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You're asking about the "SS Match," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "Each L'Arc member has what is known as a 'Star Gauge.'"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Star Gauge fills up when you train together or win races with team members...
And it fills up especially fast during Friendship Training♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"And so, once the Star Gauge is full...
you'll finally have the chance to hold a 'StarS Match Race',
or SS Match for short!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: An SS Match is a special race where members of Project L'Arc compete and push each other to greater heights, showcasing their efforts to the press and many other spectators.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
SS Matches are added to the training commands as part of training.
You can hold one with up to 5 Umamusume at a time.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Using 1 turn to hold an SS Match will boost your basic stats and Skill Pt,
as well as increase your Supporter Pt!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By the way, the icon displayed above a member's Star Gauge
indicates the basic ability that is easier to increase in an SS Match.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, in SS Matches, you can also earn
special victory bonuses depending on the members you competed against!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Winning bonuses can sometimes grant Skill Hint Levels
or Conditions, so be sure to keep an eye on the race participants as well.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, if the maximum of 5 participants join,
a "Special StarS Match Race", commonly known as
an "SSS Match", will rarely occur!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: SSS Matches are an opportunity for your trainee Umamusume to grow even further, so please be sure to hold them♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that whether an SSS Match occurs
is determined when the first 5 members gather,
and will not change as turns pass.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And during the overseas expedition, we won't be able to
invite a large press corps... so please be aware that
SS Matches themselves cannot be held.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation of
"SS Matches."
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You want to know about "Overseas Aptitude", right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In overseas races held in unfamiliar environments,
Tracen Academy's Umamusume may find themselves unable to perform to their full potential.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The eligible races are
the 'L'Arc Representative Exchange Race', 'Prix Niel',
'Prix Foy'... and the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe'.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And so! To overcome the "Challenges" facing the Umamusume,
win SS Matches and races to acquire "Overseas Aptitude"♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"After acquiring Overseas Aptitude,
you can spend Aptitude Pt to raise your Aptitude Lv
and overcome these challenges."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You can check the unlock conditions and the challenges you can overcome on the Overseas Aptitude screen, so be sure to take a look♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, some aptitudes have effects that raise
Turf or Medium aptitudes
exclusively during races in your career!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: In other words, even Umamusume who struggle with medium distances or turf have a great chance of making their mark on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever you acquire Overseas Aptitude,
make sure to actively level it up♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation
for "Overseas Aptitude".
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You want to know about "Overseas Expeditions", right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Overseas campaigns take place from early July to early October during the Classic and Senior years.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In addition to undergoing special training in France,
you can also enter the prep races, the Prix Niel
and the Prix Foy, in early September!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "You'll earn plenty of Aptitude Points during the expedition, so be sure to raise your Overseas Aptitude levels to prepare for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe in early October♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation
for "Overseas Expeditions".
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any time
by tapping the 'i' button in the top left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck.
I'll be cheering you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best,
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
